responsibility: Implements deferred emission of diagnostics within diagnostics::context. This file owns the runtime mechanics for attaching a diagnostics::buffer to a context, creating one sink-specific per_sink_buffer per active output sink, clearing buffered state, flushing buffered diagnostics back into the context, and merging buffered diagnostic counters into the live counters while re-running post-output actions such as max-error handling. It is the executable side of buffered diagnostics, distinct from the interface in buffering.h, and coordinates buffering with sink instances and context nesting/grouping invariants.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation file for the buffering pair: it defines diagnostics::context methods that attach, clear, and flush a diagnostics::buffer against the active sink set, and it implements buffer runtime behavior such as lazy per-sink buffer creation, movement, destruction, and dumping. In contrast, buffering.h only declares the buffer and per_sink_buffer abstractions and their API.
